# Site-wide Indexing Generation 2 — Discovery and Expansion

The Awtsmoos reveals one public road, then shows the roads still hidden from the crawler's eye;
Awtsmoos.com should let every true public world speak semantic truth before JavaScript paints the sky.

## Expanded mission

The first generation made aliases, discussion, translations, apps, games, Heichel roots, series, and Torah posts discoverable. Generation 2 must improve *quality* and *coverage*, not merely add URL volume.

## Work graph

1. Release proof closure
   - preserve exact deployed SHA and public verifier evidence.
2. App/game detail SEO
   - audit existing HTML metadata coverage.
   - prefer one central response-enrichment mechanism over editing dozens of pages.
   - preserve application/game runtime behavior exactly.
3. Translation discovery quality
   - locate authoritative title metadata for imported post IDs.
   - enrich catalogs only when title evidence is reliable.
   - keep paths stable and generation deterministic.
4. Alias contribution depth
   - discover existing compact indexes for authored posts/heichels/other public activity.
   - expose only public stable destinations.
   - avoid N+1 full-body reads.
5. Public route coverage
   - inventory stable public page families.
   - distinguish public content from auth/action/admin/debug routes.
   - add only intentional families to discovery.
6. Native comment future-proofing
   - add deterministic fixtures/tests proving comment sitemap shards appear and contain canonical native comment URLs when pointers exist.
7. SEO correctness
   - canonical, robots, title, description, semantic H1, ordinary links.
   - missing/deleted/private entities noindex or absent.
8. Performance
   - sitemap endpoints bounded and cached.
   - no per-page deep crawl of the whole database.
9. Release
   - test locally, commit exact paths, push race-safe, guarded production activation, raw public verification.
